text: Entry Requirements The undergraduate program applicants must be between 18-22 years old. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens who have a foreign passport and be friendly to China. A Chinese emigrant applying to study in Ningxia University must hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for at least 4 years, and in addition, the applicant must have a record of living abroad for more than two years within last four years(before April 30th of the application year). Undergraduate program applicants should be fresh high school graduates or have a high school diploma with good grades in secondary school. Applicants for bachelor's degree in Chinese Language and Literature (International Chinese Language Education Direction) should have the new HSK level 4 and the score should be above 180 points; Non-Chinese Language and Literature undergraduate applicants, Chinese level must reach the new HSK level 4 and the score should be above 240 points. No criminal record, no history of drug use. In good health, no serious infectious diseases. CSCA subjects requirements download here .
